project_name: Parohia Ortodoxă Română Sfântul Ierarh Nicolae - Sigmir
emotions_and_vibe: Sober, warm, liturgical, pastoral, deeply spiritual, accessible yet premium.
design_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST for editorial readability. Byzantine Modernism.

typography.font_pairings_instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all headings (H1-H6) to give an elegant, spiritual, orthodox liturgical feel. Use Outfit for body text to ensure maximum legibility, especially for elderly users.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] leading-none tracking-tight font-medium
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-tight tracking-tight font-medium

colors.primary_description: Byzantine Gold - use for subtle accents, separators, active states, buttons.
colors.instructions: Avoid generic whites. The entire site must feel like an old, warm parchment or smooth marble. Backgrounds should be #FDFBF7. Use Burgundy (#800020) for the Donation or Renovation section backgrounds to create a sober, serious, high-contrast moment. Use Royal Blue for subtle links or secondary buttons. Text should be a deep warm dark brown/charcoal (#2C241B) rather than pure black.

layouts_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-16, py-24, py-32 for section padding. Do not cram elements.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Asymmetrical editorial grids. A mix of full-width images and text blocks spanning 5-7 columns out of 12. Create breathing room. Avoid standard 'card' components; prefer borderless rectangular containers with pure background colors and 1px golden or subtle borders.
layouts_and_spacing.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Absolute positioning for the church sketch background image. Use mix-blend-multiply or a gentle opacity over the #FDFBF7 background so it looks drawn on the page. Text should be large, kinetic (framer-motion line reveal), left-aligned or centered, overlapping the sketch. Include an elegant scroll indicator.
layouts_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80. Must have clear links, a language switcher (RO/DE/EN), and a prominent 'Donează' button.
layouts_and_spacing.footer: Generous padding (py-24). Include address, WhatsApp contact link, and quick links.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-sm, but with refined borders. Primary button: bg-[#DAA520] text-[#2C241B]. Secondary button: transparent with border border-[#DAA520] text-[#2C241B] hover:bg-[#DAA520] hover:text-[#2C241B].
components.cards: Avoid heavily shadowed cards. Use flat, large rectangular areas. If borders are needed, use border-[#DAA520]/30.
components.marquee: Slow, organic editorial marquee. Use for spiritual quotes (e.g., 'Pace vouă • Rugați-vă neîncetat') with small gold cross SVG separators.
components.whatsapp_contact: Fixed floating button or prominent button in header/footer. Link to WhatsApp with the number 0787867540.
components.donation_section: Should be highly visible. Create a dedicated section emphasizing the internal IBAN details and a link to the external donation platform.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion for the H1 heading. Staggered fade-up for subheadings and buttons.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Sections and images should fade and slide up slightly (e.g., y: 30, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) as they enter the viewport using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero church sketch image as the user scrolls down.

hero_sketch.description: The client-provided hand-drawn sketch of the church. Use as the main hero background.

church_interior.description: Luxurious orthodox church interior with detailed frescoes.

candles.description: Low angle photo of lightened candles in the dark.

media_and_assets.icons_instructions: Use lucide-react. Prefer clean, thin lines. No emojis for icons. Use a custom SVG cross where an orthodox cross is needed (e.g., separators).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast is high. Use the deep brown/charcoal (#2C241B) against the light beige (#FDFBF7) background.
accessibility.font_size: Body text must be text-lg or larger to cater to elderly users.
accessibility.interactions: Provide clear focus states. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Awwwards level.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors.
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use solid background colors for headers over content. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds where text would become unreadable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Install and use lenis for smooth scrolling, framer-motion for animations.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their classes to remove the default 'SaaS/Vercel' look, fitting the Byzantine modern aesthetic.
